skill.description: Plan a paid-media bid strategy using campaign goals, conversion history, and learning-phase constraints. It recommends tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, or manual CPC with transparent target math.

security_audit.summary: The 57 static alerts are false positives from Markdown links, backticks, headings, and homepage metadata; the skill contains no executed shell commands, network requests, or system reconnaissance. A medium-risk design issue remains: the documented save filename includes an unsanitized campaign placeholder. The content also explicitly treats imported data as untrusted input.

remediation.issue: Campaign names are inserted into the documented result path without a filename-safety rule.
remediation.suggestion: Require a slugified campaign identifier, reject path separators and dot segments, resolve the final path under memory/ad/bid-strategy-planner, and show the target path before writing.

semantic_findings.title: Unsanitized Campaign Name in Save Path
semantic_findings.description: The documented save path interpolates <campaign> into a filename after confirmation, but it does not require filename sanitization or restrict path separators. A hostile campaign value could cause an agent implementation to write outside the intended memory directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The save instruction explicitly includes a user-supplied campaign placeholder in the path and gives no validation rule. User confirmation reduces accidental writes but does not prevent traversal through the filename.

content.value_statement: Paid campaigns can lose delivery when bidding targets do not match conversion history. This skill selects a suitable strategy, derives a starting target, and plans a stable learning-phase entry.
actual_capabilities: Select tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, or manual CPC from stated goals and conversion volume.
Derive a starting tCPA or tROAS from supplied historical CPA or ROAS.
Label planning inputs as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated.
Group compatible campaigns into bid portfolios based on goals, targets, and funnel stage.
Create a learning-phase entry plan with a do-not-touch window and reset risks.
limitations: It does not access advertising platforms or change campaign settings.
It needs user-provided conversion history for a data-backed tCPA or tROAS target.
Its thresholds are estimated rules of thumb, not platform guarantees.
It does not allocate budgets or manage in-flight pacing.

use_cases.title: Launch a direct-response campaign
use_cases.description: Choose a starting tCPA for a new campaign with recent CPA and conversion-volume data.

use_cases.title: Set a revenue bidding target
use_cases.description: Create a tROAS entry plan from ecommerce revenue and historical ROAS.

use_cases.title: Organize related search campaigns
use_cases.description: Map compatible campaigns into portfolios while keeping prospecting and direct response separate.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a basic strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a bid strategy for my lead-generation campaign. We had 35 conversions in 30 days at a $40 CPA.

prompt_templates.title: Set a tROAS target
prompt_templates.prompt: Set a starting tROAS target for an ecommerce campaign. The last 30 days produced 3.6x ROAS and 55 conversions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a campaign portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Group these campaigns into bid portfolios: two direct-response search campaigns at similar CPAs, one prospecting campaign, and one brand campaign with a hard bid cap.

prompt_templates.title: Create a learning-phase plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a learning-phase entry plan for a campaign moving from max-conversions to tCPA. Use 42 monthly conversions and a $48 trailing CPA.

output_examples.input: A lead campaign has 90 conversions in 30 days and a $42 trailing CPA.
output: Starting target: about $42 to $46, based on the trailing CPA.
Learning plan: avoid target and budget changes during the initial learning window.

output_examples.input: A prospecting campaign has limited conversion data.
output: Recommended strategy: max-conversions or manual CPC.
Reason: the conversion signal is too thin for a reliable target strategy.
Next step: revisit tCPA after conversion volume becomes adequate.

best_practices: Provide trailing 30-day CPA or ROAS and conversion volume before requesting a target.
Keep direct-response and prospecting campaigns in separate portfolios.
Change targets gradually after the learning phase has stabilized.
anti_patterns: Do not set a tCPA or tROAS target from an aspirational goal without supporting history.
Do not change targets or budgets repeatedly during the learning phase.
Do not combine campaigns with incompatible goals or economics in one portfolio.

faq.question: Does this skill change my ad account?
faq.answer: No. It produces a planning recommendation and does not access or modify advertising platforms.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, trailing CPA or ROAS, conversion volume, and any important bidding constraints.

faq.question: When does it recommend tCPA?
faq.answer: It recommends tCPA when the campaign has a fixed-CPA goal and enough recent conversion volume.

faq.question: When does it recommend tROAS?
faq.answer: It recommends tROAS when revenue value data and sufficient conversion volume support a revenue goal.

faq.question: Can it plan campaign portfolios?
faq.answer: Yes. It groups campaigns only when their goals, targets, and funnel stages are compatible.

faq.question: Does it manage live pacing?
faq.answer: No. It plans entry strategy only. Live pacing and budget adjustments require a separate workflow.
